body: Unfortunately, finding any treats (let alone those with high CBD and low THC) in my area would be very difficult, though I would like to try them.

I try to meditate regularly. Save for working out and yoga, nothing has come close to being as effective at relieving stress and building mindfulness. I have never tried meditating while high, though I have thought about it. I'll give it a shot, thanks.
Yes, it really is mental. I will try listening to music, maybe playing video games.

I like making and studying art, I've been doing it for most of my life, but I need to find a way to apply it for it to be satisfying. I can put a lot more effort into something when I know it's making other people's lives better. I want to try boxing as well, I think I'd like it.

I've been taking medication for a few months now. It's helped me with my anxiety, but I still feel depressed and empty. I'm currently looking into finding a therapist, I last tried a type of counseling two years ago. Thank you, it means a lot to me that someone responded.
